 O R D E R
Application for impleadment/intervention is allowed.
Leave granted.

The appellants have been arraigned as accused for the offences punishable under Sections 120B,
406, 420, 467, 468, 201 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Sections 7 and 7A of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, Sections 4, 7,
8 and 11 of the Chhattisgarh Gambling (Prohibition) Act, 2022 and Section 4A of the Public Gambling Act, 1867.
We had adjourned this matter twice only for the purpose of enabling the respondents to proceed with further investigation.

As the major part of the investigation is stated to have been completed, and taking into consideration not only the period of incarceration undergone by the CRL A @ SLP [CRL.] NO.703/2025 AND CONNCTD MATTERS  2 appellants but also the fact that the co-accused and some of the appellants have already been granted bail in the cases registered for the offences punishable under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002, we are inclined to hold that their continued incarceration is not required,

Accordingly, the impugned order(s) stand set aside and the appellants are granted bail on terms and conditions to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
The appeals stand allowed, accordingly.
